reading: The quartic code detects any single-register error and corrects one known lost register exactly (distance 2), as the source document states; two lost registers or one error at an unknown place are not correctable.  Random rank-5 subspaces, also inside Sym^4, do not have this property, so within this comparison the code is special.  In absolute terms it is a small detection code: 8 physical qubits for log2(5) = 2.32 logical qubits at distance 2, the same distance as the textbook [[4,2,2]] code, which stores 2 qubits in 4.
